description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Monarch Investment & Management Group is hiring a Junior Applications Developer to support, maintain, and improve internal applications. The role builds automation tools and lightweight applications, assists with API integrations, and uses AI to streamline workflows and development.
Junior internal applications developer building automation tools, integrating APIs, and troubleshooting business systems

Responsibilities:
• Support, maintain, and improve internal applications
• Build automation tools and lightweight applications
• Assist with API integrations (including Yardi and other systems)
• Experiment with AI to streamline workflows and development
• Troubleshoot issues and optimize system performance
• Collaborate with senior developers while owning your work

Requirements:
• Experience (professional, academic, or internship) in software or application development
• Exposure to Python, C#, Node.js, or similar
• Basic understanding of APIs, SQL/databases, and integrations
• Familiarity with frameworks like Django, Flask, or .NET Core
• Experience with Git/version control

Preferred:
• Cloud or serverless exposure (Azure, etc.)
• Basic front-end skills (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)

Skills:

• Experience with Git/version control
• Cloud or serverless exposure (Azure, etc.)

Pay: $80K/yr - $90K/yr
